decision: Require explicit verified-response evidence before REAL-WORKER READY qualification

reviews.reason: service-call presence cannot prove the response used by qualification passed Ed25519 verification
rejects worker-declared or stale attestations and unexpected endpoints
adds no qrexec round trips, daemon, database, or production coordinator mutation

alternatives.name: trust qrexec_service_call events
alternatives.rejected: worker-side events are not cryptographic proof

alternatives.name: external attestation service
alternatives.rejected: stronger future option but adds key lifecycle, IPC, resources, latency, and failure modes before real-Qubes evidence exists

winner: transport-boundary Ed25519 verification followed by explicit attestation_verified evidence and fail-closed aggregate qualification
lessons: Cryptographic verification that is not represented in readiness evidence cannot strengthen the final readiness decision.
Qualification must bind evidence to the expected coordinator key, git SHA, and exact normal/fault qrexec services.
The crash leg may intentionally produce no response; recovery and successful normal/fault probes provide the attestable response evidence.
remainingGate: Wire the attested aggregate evaluator into the qualification runner, add negative regression tests, obtain green Node/Swift CI, then run on real Qubes.
